# OpenCL C headers

Copied from KhronosGroup/OpenCL-Headers tag v2024.10.24,
commit 4ea6df132107e3b4b9407f903204b5522fdffcd6.

Included: CL/cl.h, CL/cl_platform.h, CL/cl_version.h and LICENSE.
License: Apache-2.0. Upstream: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenCL-Headers

The application dynamically loads the GPU driver's OpenCL library and uses
OpenCL 1.2 C APIs. These headers do not provide an OpenCL runtime or driver.
